name: Tesserae
description: Tesserae is a self-hosted dashboard server for e-ink panels. It composes tile-based dashboards from weather, calendar, Home Assistant and other widgets, renders them in a headless browser, and pushes the frames to ESP32 boards, TRMNL devices and KOReader readers over HTTP or MQTT.

app_vars.name: var_tesserae_channel
app_vars.label: Release channel
app_vars.help: stable follows tagged releases; edge tracks the main branch and updates on every commit

notes.text: The first visit opens the setup wizard: pick an admin password, then follow the onboarding steps for timezone, transport, device and first dashboard.
Authentication is a single password gate meant for a trusted LAN. Do not expose the container to the internet; use a VPN for remote access.
Dashboards, settings and device registrations live in /opt/tesserae_data. Back up that directory; /opt/tesserae is replaced on every update.
